items.t: Stock Market Today, Nov. 18: Recursion Pharmaceuticals Rises 4% on FDA Alignment for REC-4881 Phase 3 Design
items.sum: On Nov. 18, 2026, Recursion shares climbed after regulators aligned on its lead familial adenomatous polyposis trial, though investors are watching for more detail.

items.t: Why Recursion Pharmaceuticals Stock Is Up Today
items.sum: This pharmaceutical-development technology company continues to demonstrate that its testing platform has real potential.

items.t: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Lowers Price Target to $5.6
items.sum: Morgan Stanley analyst Vikram Purohit maintains Recursion Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RXRX) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $5.9 to $5.6.

items.t: Recursion Announces Alignment with FDA on Registrational Phase 3 Trial Design for REC-4881 in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis
items.sum: REC-4881 is among the first AI-enabled programs to advance a registrational Phase 3 trial design for a disease with no approved pharmacologic therapies. Its potential as a first-in-class oral therapy for FAP was identified through unbiased phenotypic screening using Recursion’s AI foundation models. items.t: What Recursion Pharmaceuticals Investors Missed Before The Fall
items.sum: If you picked Recursion Pharmaceuticals for its AI-first pitch and deep pharma ties, the past year has probably felt rough. Investors who held Recursion Pharmaceuticals from the start of the year are down 35.2%, including dividends. If you made that call because analysts expected rapid revenue growth, improving margins and a rich future P/E multiple, what did that original thesis miss about clinic
